statements.quote: We are on track to deliver record revenue with solid profitability and free cash flow in fiscal 2025, while we make disciplined investments to build on our technology leadership and manufacturing excellence to satisfy growing AI-driven memory demand.
statements.notes: The CEO quote links 'disciplined investments' to AI-driven memory demand but never says 'capital expenditures'. 'Manufacturing excellence' most plausibly means capex, so it is recorded as capex. The investments are framed as company-wide and driven by AI demand, so scope is total, not the AI part. Kind is outlook because fiscal 2025 was not complete at the Q3 release ('on track').

none_found.reason: no sentence quantifies or attributes R&D, infrastructure or headcount expense to AI; 'technology leadership' investments in p01 may imply R&D, but that is too indirect to record
